comment: Scenarios that cannot pass in fixture mode because of a property of the installed vendor CLI or its protocol, not a regression. See REVIEW.md 'Known Environment Limitations'. Any other failing scenario fails the release gate; an entry here that starts passing also fails the gate and must be removed.
switchComment: Recorded against `crewd conformance --adapter <kind> --fixture` with CREW_DISABLE_VENDOR_CLI=1 set, which is how CI runs this gate (see the `test` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml and the `conformance` job in .github/workflows/release.yml, both of which set it). Fixture mode never spawns a vendor CLI under that switch, so every scenario whose only proof is a real vendor process is reported as an honest skip (outcome: "skipped") rather than a fabricated pass or a disproof. A skip is unproven, so it must stay listed here to satisfy this gate's coverage check; it is never a failure and is never read as one. Running fixture mode with the switch unset on a machine that has the vendor CLIs installed will make several of these actually pass and trip this gate's own rotting-baseline check -- that is expected, not a regression: reconcile against the switch-set run.
